Geopolitical instability, significant policy changes, or even sector-specific disruptions like technological breakthroughs or regulatory shifts could also cause outcomes to fall far outside the expected range. These types of "black swan" events, by their unpredictable nature, are difficult to fully quantify within standard probabilistic models but hold the potential to significantly impact the actual value, either positively or negatively.
